items.label: Max Drawdown
items.detail: Trails upward based on End-of-Day balance (closed P&L only). Intraday peaks do NOT affect it. Stops trailing once it reaches starting balance. Example: $100K start → floor at $97K, rises with EOD balance, locks when EOD exceeds starting balance.

items.label: Daily Pause
items.detail: No daily loss limit / daily pause rule on Futures Prime accounts.

items.label: Min Trading Days
items.detail: Must place a trade on at least 3 separate calendar days to pass. Overnight holds do not count as a new trading day.

items.label: Consistent Size
items.detail: Avoid large deviations in position sizes vs. your usual pattern. Example breach: 10 contracts Day 1–2, then 1 contract on Day 3 (minimum day) = violation.

items.label: Inactivity Limit
items.detail: 21 consecutive days without placing a trade = account breached. Countdown starts immediately at purchase. Overnight holds and pending orders do not count.

items.label: Challenge Duration
items.detail: Calendar days including weekends and holidays. Cannot be paused or stopped.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: News trading fully permitted on Futures Prime (challenge and earning). Be aware of heightened volatility risk.

items.label: Overnight Hold
items.detail: Positions still open at 14:55 CT are force-closed by Risk Managers. No exceptions.

items.label: Weekend Hold
items.detail: All positions must be closed before Friday market close. Weekend holding = breach.

items.label: Scalping
items.detail: Scalping is permitted on all Futures Prime accounts.

items.label: Micro-Scalping
items.detail: Opening and closing within 10–15 seconds as a primary profit strategy is banned. Flagged when ≥40% of profitable trades are ultra-short-term. Challenge: warning. Earning: profit deducted.

items.label: HFT
items.detail: Any speed/latency exploitation, multiple trades per second, rapid-fire entries = account termination.

items.label: Grid / Martingale
items.detail: High-risk systematic strategies not allowed on any account.

items.label: Gap Trading
items.detail: No trades within 2 hours of market close when market stays closed 2+ hours. No pre-news gap positioning.

items.label: Copy Trading
items.detail: Manual or auto copy allowed across up to 5 accounts. More than 5 = firm may deny upgrade on additional accounts.

items.label: Restricted Instruments
items.detail: CL, NG, QG (Energy) · GC, SI, HG, PL (Metals) — All standard contracts SUSPENDED until further notice. Resumes to normal after market conditions stabilize.

items.label: Micro Commodity Limits
items.detail: MCL, MGC, SIL, MHG, MNG only. $50K → max 2 open · $100K → max 4 open · $150K → max 6 open. ⚠️ These limits are temporary. Normal limits return after restrictions are lifted.

items.label: Status
items.detail: Restrictions remain in place. Monitor official communications at support@thetradingpit.com for updates.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: Trader receives 80% of profits. A 1% fee deducted from payout to cover transaction/gas fees.

items.label: Payout Cap
items.detail: Each payout = min($5,000, 50% of total realized profit). Applies to every cycle including first.

items.label: Winning Days Req.
items.detail: 5 profitable trading days (non-consecutive), each with net profit ≥ $200. Counter resets after every payout.

items.label: Profit Since Last
items.detail: From 2nd payout onwards, must show any profit (even $0.01) above last payout baseline before requesting next.

items.label: Activation Fee
items.detail: Activation fee currently waived across all account sizes.

items.label: Max Challenge Accounts
items.detail: No cap on challenge purchases. Copy trades allowed in up to 5 accounts simultaneously.

items.label: Max Earning Accounts
items.detail: Max 5 active earning accounts at a time. New passes are queued until a slot opens.

items.label: Merging
items.detail: Futures Prime earning accounts can only be merged with other Futures Prime accounts.
